text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s for the t-h-r-e-e p-a-r-t-i-c-i-p-a-t-i-n-g f-i-r-m-s using s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g s-h-e-e-t-s, which l-e-f-t a n-a-t-s p-r-i-c-i-n-g w-o-r-k-b-o-o-k as the t-r-a-c-e, and the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t b-i-d p-r-e-p-a-r-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d

2) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e of w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-s through s-e-c-r-e-t m-e-s-s-a-g-i-n-g c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s, which l-e-f-t c-h-a-t t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d

3) the actor s-e-t u-p h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s between c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s using o-f-f-b-o-o-k a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, which l-e-f-t t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the p-u-b-l-i-c f-i-l-i-n-g r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d

4) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d s-e-n-s-i-t-i-v-e p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n with r-i-v-a-l b-i-d-d-e-r-s outside the f-o-r-m-a-l p-r-o-c-e-s-s, which l-e-f-t e-m-a-i-l m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a as the t-r-a-c-e, and the c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d

5) the actor s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d the t-e-n-d-e-r s-o t-o a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e by v-a-r-y-i-n-g b-i-d a-m-o-u-n-t-s a-r-t-i-f-i-c-i-a-l-l-y, which l-e-f-t an i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-t b-i-d h-i-s-t-o-r-y as the t-r-a-c-e, and the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
